verifier_reason: test_outputs.py::test_filter_blocks_xss: The test failed in the call phase due to an assertion error

items.name: Readability
items.evidence: filter.py (4.8KB) is not shown, only described. It relies on dense regexes like `<script\b(?:[^"'\>]|"[^"]*"|'[^']*')*?/>...` and `([\s/]+)([^\s/>="']+)...`, which are hard to read and need comments. Readability can't be verified beyond that.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Uses a tokenising regex approach rather than str.replace chains. But it left a /app/scratch/ folder holding test_*.py and run_tests.py, and ran filter.py on run_tests.py, rewriting that file in place. Structure of filter.py itself is unverified.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Reads argv[1] and writes in place. There's no evidence of argument validation or explicit-encoding handling, and the code wasn't shown. The regex fallback `(?:</script\s*>|$)` covers unclosed script tags, but malformed-input robustness is unproven.

items.name: Obfuscated vectors neutralised
items.evidence: Covers script tags, on* attributes and javascript:/vbscript:/data:text/html URLs. It does not remove iframe/frame/object/embed/base/meta refresh elements (only srcdoc is stripped). Hidden test_filter_blocks_xss FAILED.

items.name: Minimal edits on dirty documents
items.name_zh: 含恶意内容的文档仅做最小修改
items.evidence: Token-level edits are meant to keep formatting intact, but hidden test_clean_html_unchanged FAILED, so benign documents are being changed. That still looks like over-stripping of some attributes, not wholesale removal.
